2607.26627.title: Revisiting Lossy Verification in Speculative Decoding: Mechanisms, Trade-offs, and Failure Modes
2607.26627.paper_summary: Speculative Decoding (SD) accelerates large language model inference by allowing a lightweight draft model to propose tokens that are subsequently verified in parallel by a larger target model. Recent approaches introduce lossy verification schemes to further improve efficiency by relaxing strict distributional matching. Yet such relaxation silently rewrites the decoding distribution, and the resulting acceleration can come at the cost of unstable, sometimes severely degraded generation quality. In this work, we present a principled analysis of the distributions induced by lossy verification methods. We show that many seemingly distinct approaches differ only superficially and can be classified into two categories: truncation-based verification and collaborative verification. We further construct a diagnostic evaluation framework across curated benchmarks. For truncation-based methods, we identify a fundamental pitfall: performance can degrade significantly compared to the true truncation sampling baseline due to distributional distortion. For collaborative verification, we uncover a key principles: controlling the overshoot of draft probabilities relative to target probabilities is essential to prevent low-quality outputs. Our code is available at https://github.com/ZhouYuxuanYX/Fast-HSD.
2607.26627.paper_summary_zh: 推測解碼（SD）透過允許輕量級草稿模型提出令牌，進而由更大型的目標模型並行驗證，來加速大型語言模型的推理。最近的方法引入了有損驗證方案，進一步通過放寬嚴格的分佈匹配來提高效率。然而，這種放寬默默地改寫了解碼分佈，所帶來的加速可能以不穩定、有時嚴重退化的生成質量為代價。在本研究中，我們對有損驗證方法所引起的分佈進行了原則性的分析。我們顯示許多看似不同的方法僅在表面上有所不同，並可以分為兩類：基於截斷的驗證和協作驗證。我們進一步構建了一個跨經過策劃的基準的診斷評估框架。對於基於截斷的方法，我們識別出一個根本性的陷阱：由於分佈扭曲，性能可能與真實的截斷抽樣基線相比顯著下降。對於協作驗證，我們發現了一個關鍵原則：控制草稿概率相對於目標概率的超出是防止低質量輸出的關鍵。我們的代碼可在 https://github.com/ZhouYuxuanYX/Fast-HSD 獲得。
